item.title: Philadelphia Buried Under Heaviest Snowfall in Decade
item.description: Philadelphia was hit with 9.1 inches of snow Sunday — the city’s biggest snowfall in 10 years — followed by hours of sleet that created treacherous icy conditions, expected to stick around for days as temperatures plummet into single digits.
